title: OrderPaymentInitiated
description: Published by the Click and Collect payment initiation job for each order whose picked quantities are ready to be charged. Messages are ordered on tenant and business unit.

orderId.description: Id of the customer order payment is initiated for

fulfillmentId.description: Id of the store fulfillment payment is initiated for

businessUnitId.description: Id of the business unit fulfilling the order

paymentType.description: Payment type recorded on the order payment row

reservedAmount.description: Amount reserved for the order, carried as a string to preserve scale

additionalProperties.description: Reserved for future use. The producer always sends an empty array

PaymentInitiatedLine.description: One order line included in the payment

itemId.description: Id of the item on the order line

pickedQuantity.description: Quantity picked for the line. Null when no quantity was recorded

additionalProperties.description: Reserved for future use. The producer always sends an empty array

substitutions.description: Substituted items picked against this line. Null rather than an empty array when the line has no substitutions

PaymentInitiatedSubstitution.description: One substituted item picked against an order line

pickedQuantity.description: Quantity picked of the substituted item. Null when no quantity was recorded

additionalProperties.description: Reserved for future use. The producer always sends an empty array
